episodes.title: Cachu Hwch
episodes.summary: Comedy in which actors David Tennant and Michael Sheen play themselves as they prepare for a stage production while under lockdown. The Good Omens co-stars were due to put on a play in the West End before the production was put on hold because of the coronavirus pandemic. Not wanting to let his big break pass him by, director Simon Evans must do his best to convince his doubtful actors to carry on rehearsals online.

episodes.title: Up to No Good
episodes.summary: With rehearsals due to begin, director Simon goes missing. Michael and David embrace the opportunity to skive off from their duties, but one of them gets caught breaking the law. Georgia is due to deliver her novel to her agent and asks David to stand in and help with the kids.

episodes.title: Who The F#!k Is Michael Sheen?
episodes.summary: An actor who was initially involved in the play, but dropped out due to scheduling conflicts, comes back to haunt the production. Georgia has sold her novel, and tells Anna that she's due to be a birthing partner for her friend. Michael is being blackmailed by his neighbour.

episodes.title: Bara Brith
episodes.summary: Michael and David are finding it hard to regain each other's trust. The show's producer steps in to try and repair the damage. Meanwhile Michael gets drawn deeper into the situation with his neighbour. David is nervous about Georgia going off to help a friend who's in labour.

episodes.title: Ulysses
episodes.summary: Simon brings in an old friend to try to convince David and Michael to put their faith in him. David has managed to stay afloat in Georgia's absence. Not only has he kept the house in order and the home-schooling ticking over, but he's finished a draft of his screenplay. Michael spies an ambulance next door and worries about his neighbour.

episodes.title: The Cookie Jar
episodes.summary: The producer drafts in the voice of experience to get Michael and David in line. Georgia has shared David's work without him knowing. Michael seeks resolution on what has happened to his neighbour. David is pleasantly surprised by the enthusiastic response his work receives.

episodes.title: Saddle Up Sheen!
episodes.summary: Whilst appearing on a chat show discussing a year in lockdown Michael and David are pained to discover someone they respect is not a fan of their work. David's plans to go to work and Michael's plans to visit a friend abroad are both scuppered by last minute travel rule changes. Some news regarding a work opportunity for the pair turns sour.

episodes.title: Long Time, No See
episodes.summary: After discovering the network's plan, David and Michael are dismayed to learn news about who will be going out to America without them. The guys are also upset to find out how well Simon is doing without them.

episodes.title: The Dirty Mochyns
episodes.summary: David and Michael spot an opportunity to sabotage the show. Anna and Georgia consider their options.

episodes.title: Woofty Doofty, David
episodes.summary: There is fallout from how David and Michael have behaved. They try to establish who has more value. Georgia, Anna and Lucy discuss a charity evening that they are due to perform at.

episodes.title: The Warthog and the Mongoose Pt. 1
episodes.summary: The boys are butting heads, not helped by having to read with various new potential cast members. They are increasingly annoyed at each new interaction while Simon tries to keep the ship steady and Georgia marshals her charity team.

episodes.title: The Warthog and the Mongoose Pt. 2
episodes.summary: The project is in real danger. Simon hears desperate news from Georgia, via Lucy, and tries (once more) to get David and Michael to work together. But it ultimately falls to a final pair of new potential cast members to offer David and Michael a new perspective on their friendship. But is it too late?

episodes.title: The Loo Recluse
episodes.summary: David and Michael discover that the studio has now cast two actors. When they discover who has been cast both men are upset as they each have a history with the actor taking their place, one known and one unknown.

episodes.title: Until They Get Home
episodes.summary: Accepting their fate David and Michael prepare to finally leave their homes. David is finally due to go back to work, Michael thinks he finally has a route to New York. The girls perform their charity sketch.

episodes.title: A Version of This
episodes.summary: Michael and David don't want to talk to Simon, but he doesn't give up.

episodes.title: Who's Playing Who?
episodes.summary: The gang prepares to announce their new endeavour. Surely nothing can stand in their way?

episodes.title: Past
episodes.summary: Sifting through the rubble of what might have been, they try to pin-point what went wrong.

episodes.title: Present
episodes.summary: With the project paused, David and Michael decide to try and break the standstill.

episodes.title: Future
episodes.summary: With the gang reinvigorated, a plan is suggested which could turn failure into glory.

episodes.title: Knock, Knock
episodes.summary: The final send-off is upset by betrayal almost at once. But is there still a way through?
